# Orvio 0.39

- Sign in on your TV with your phone: the TV shows a code and a QR code. On your phone, go to Settings › Account › Sign in a TV and enter the code and your password. No more typing with the remote.
- Delete your account from Settings › Account. This removes your account and everything synced to it; what is on your device stays.
- Mark films, series and episodes as watched. Finishing one marks it automatically, and "Hide watched" (TV) or "Unwatched" (phone) keeps your catalog fresh. On TV, hold OK on an episode to mark it.
- Get a notification when a series you follow (a favourite, or one you are watching) has a new episode.
- Every film and series page now has a Trailer button.
- On Google TV and Android TV, titles you are halfway through appear in "Continue watching" on the home screen.
- Live TV reconnects by itself when a stream drops or stalls.
- Crashes and streams that fail to play are reported anonymously, so problems can be fixed faster. No names, e-mail addresses or stream links are sent.
- A new look for buttons, filters, fields and messages, with smooth animations and a glow on the focused button on TV.
